items.title: James Lincoln Collier interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2007
items.q: There was one we used to do all the time called “She Looks Like Helen Brown.” I’ve never heard of it since.

ctx.x: Give me two or three songs that would have been on your playlist.

Well we played all those standard things, “Muskrat Ramble” and “The Saints Go Marching In,” and “Black and Blue” and oh the blues of course and probably “Memphis Blues,” I can’t remember exactly. There was one we used to do all the time called “She Looks Like Helen Brown.” I’ve never heard of it since. I could probably still play it if I had to.
Did the college have any input, any opinion, any other thing to do with what you were doing?
